title: Bollywood's Biggest Stars Turn Out for Ambani Family Ganpati Celebrations
excerpt: The Ambani family's Ganesh Chaturthi celebration at Antilia on September 14 drew a who's-who of Bollywood and cricket, with stars from Salman Khan to Alia Bhatt arriving for the evening's aarti.
body:
• The Ambani family hosted its annual Ganesh Chaturthi celebration at Antilia in South Mumbai on Monday, September 14.
  • The guest list spanned Bollywood's biggest names — Salman Khan, Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt, Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan, Ranveer Singh, Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal — alongside cricketers including Sachin Tendulkar.
  • Antilia was decked out with elaborate lighting, large floral installations and temple-style decor for the evening's aarti.
  • Host Nita Ambani greeted arriving guests personally, in traditional wear with statement jewellery.

Mumbai's most-watched Ganpati gathering

The Ambani family's annual Ganesh Chaturthi celebration at Antilia once again pulled together a sprawling guest list of Bollywood's biggest names, all arriving to seek Lord Ganesha's blessings on Monday evening. The South Mumbai residence, transformed each year with elaborate lighting, large floral installations and temple-style decor, hosted the evening's aarti as stars, sports icons and public figures arrived through the afternoon and evening.

https://x.com/DeccanChronicle/status/2099723414848385288

According to The Hollywood Reporter India, Monday's turnout read like an industry roll call. Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan attended with her sister Karisma Kapoor and children Taimur and Jehangir. Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt arrived together, as did Ranveer Singh, Salman Khan, Janhvi, Khushi and Arjun Kapoor, Madhuri Dixit with husband Shriram Nene, and Katrina Kaif with Vicky Kaushal. The long guest list also included Disha Patani, Kriti Sanon, Karan Johar, Kajol, Boman Irani, Anil Kapoor, Sanjay Dutt, Jackie Shroff, Rekha, Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani, Varun Dhawan with wife Natasha Dalal, and Riteish Deshmukh and Genelia D'Souza.

Cricket had a presence too: Sachin Tendulkar, Harbhajan Singh and Deepak Chahar attended with their families, while Suniel Shetty arrived with his wife Mana Shetty. Producer Gauri Khan was spotted with her mother.

Context & background

Antilia's Ganpati celebrations have become a fixture of Mumbai's festival calendar, according to The Hollywood Reporter India. The multi-day event typically draws not just film and cricket stars but also industrialists, politicians and international figures for the aartis and cultural programming that follow. Host Nita Ambani greeted arriving guests and members of the media herself, dressed in traditional wear with statement jewellery.

Filmibeat reported that the celebrations remained centered on devotion and tradition, even as the celebrity fashion and festive moments became a major talking point on social media. Videos and pictures of the arrivals gained traction online within hours, as they do each year.

What the stars wore

The arrivals were a study in festive dressing. Kareena Kapoor Khan wore a bright yellow ethnic outfit with silver embroidery and statement jewellery, while Saif Ali Khan complemented her in a red kurta with white bottoms. Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani drew the cameras too — Kiara in a soft pink saree with delicate embellishments, a green necklace and traditional jewellery, and Sidharth in a printed kurta with white trousers, according to Filmibeat.

Salman Khan took a more relaxed approach: a light blue striped shirt with denim, a white printed headscarf, a chain and a watch. Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor went traditional, while Ranveer Singh, Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal all turned heads among the crowds of photographers stationed outside Antilia.

Diaspora angle

For Indian-Americans and the wider diaspora, Ganesh Chaturthi is celebrated in scaled-down form in temples and community centers across the US and UK. The Antilia gathering functions as the festival's most visible expression — the version that fills social media feeds the next morning, from the Midwest to Wembley.

What's next

The Antilia celebrations typically continue across the festival's multi-day run with further aartis and cultural programming, drawing more guests from Mumbai's business and public life. The visarjan, marking the immersion that closes the festival, brings the city's celebrations to their traditional finale.
